overall: MARGINAL overall, improving: six grounds GOOD (Tara, Decabobo, Turda, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan), two MARGINAL, four POOR and four VERY POOR
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination of wind and current. Wind: Nangalao 20 kt (gusts 26), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 18 kt (gusts 23), Barangonan 18 kt, Ciron 18 kt (gusts 23), Linapacan 13 kt. Current: Decabaitot 1.6 kt, Alava and Barangonan 1.5 kt now, easing to about 1.0 kt by 9 AM. For reference, 9.7 kt is about 18 kph, the line fishermen treat as bad. Rain is not a factor in the next 24h (0.0–0.1 mm/h).

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the last digest (Fri 13, 2:20 PM)
items: Fishing improved: the mix is now 6 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 4 VERY POOR (was 4 GOOD / 4 MARGINAL / 7 POOR / 1 VERY POOR). Galoc and Maglalambay moved back up to GOOD (5–6 kt), joining Tara, Decabobo, Turda and Panlaitan. Coron and Linapacan are MARGINAL. But Decabaitot, Alava and Barangonan fell to VERY POOR on the early-morning current pulse (1.5–1.6 kt now), and Nangalao stays VERY POOR (20 kt, gusts 26).

Regional wind: Sat 14 11 kt, gusts 16; Sun 15 8.3 kt with light rain (1.9 mm); Mon 16 10 kt; Tue 17 11 kt; Wed 18 5.6 kt (calmest); Thu 19 9.4 kt; Fri 20 15 kt, gusts 22 (rough). Supply: slightly soft today and Sun; near normal Mon; better Wed. Shortage detector ELEVATED, surge OFF. PAGASA feed read OK this run: CLEAR (no gale/TCWS/heavy-rain alert for Calamian/MIMAROPA).

bestWindow.headline: Now through about 3 PM at Tara, Decabobo, Turda and Panlaitan; Galoc, Coron and Culion before about 9 AM and again after 6 PM (wind 2.5–5 kt)
details: Sun 15 is the best fishing day (8.3 kt, light rain), lifting Mon 16 arrivals; Wed 18 is the calmest (5.6 kt). Fri 20 turns rough (15 kt, gusts 22).

Tara, Decabobo and Turda: wind 2–8 kt all day, current 0.0–0.4 kt until about 3 PM, then 0.7–0.9 kt (Tara, Turda) about 6–9 PM. Galoc, Coron and Culion: wind 5 kt now but 11 kt about noon; calm 2.5–4 kt after dark (Galoc current 0.2–0.4). Panlaitan and Maglalambay: wind 1–6 kt until about 3 PM, current 0.1–0.4 kt.
Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan (14–20 kt), and avoid Decabaitot, Alava and Barangonan before about 9 AM (current 1.5–1.6 kt).
